## Hex 2.1.24

- Updates the local transcription engine (transcribe-cpp 0.2.4). Transcripts
  from the bundled Parakeet models are unchanged, and transcription is about
  20% faster in local benchmarks.
- Updates the audio resampler, the Effect runtime used by personal commands
  (now Effect 4.0.0), and other app dependencies. Existing personal-command
  workspaces are migrated to Effect 4.0.0 automatically.

This macOS maintenance release uses build 20124. The public TypeScript SDK
remains at 0.3.1. No Linux binary is published with this release.
